**Comparison of shaar-back (back cover) page:**

**1) Background/decorative frame presence:**
Both sides show an identical light-gray decorative background panel occupying the left portion of the page. Match.

**2) Text element positions:**
Both sides show the same four text elements spread across the page at defined vertical positions (not clustered/compressed in the center):
- "כל הרווחים שמורים" / "כל ההוגמנים" (or similar subtitle)
- "הואצה הספר ביל"ט"
- "052-7666666"
- "אימייל: מאיר עו"ד דההוד"

Horizontal placement (centered within the text zone, right of the gray panel) matches on both sides.

**3) Vertical spacing between text blocks:**
The gaps between the four text blocks are essentially identical — same vertical rhythm on both sides, with the same large spacing between blocks.

**4) Overall parity:**
Text content, font size/weight, alignment, gray panel geometry, and vertical distribution all match. Differences are limited to sub-pixel rendering/antialiasing noise.

**Verdict: PARITY OK** ✅
